description: This file defines a React component for a control interface to manage smart lights, including device selection, switching on/off, changing color, and adjusting brightness. It interfaces with backend APIs to fetch device data and send control commands.

methods.name: ControlsPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the smart light controls interface.

methods.name: setLight
methods.description: Function to turn the light on or off.

methods.name: submitColor
methods.description: Function to change the light's color.

methods.name: submitBrightness
methods.description: Function to adjust the brightness of the light.
